info.title: Yang's Fried Rice - System API
info.description: Interactive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for Menu Management, Administration, Order Oversight, and Reporting. Use 'Try it out' to execute live requests.

get.description: Fetches all categories from the database, sorted alphabetically.

post.description: Inserts a new category record. You may supply a custom UUID `category_id` (e.g. `c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`). If the ID is duplicate, a 409 Conflict error is returned.

400.description: Validation failure (invalid category name or UUID)

example.error: Category ID "c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" already exists. Duplicate IDs are not allowed.

get.description: Fetches a single category record by its UUID.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the category to update (e.g. c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001)

delete.description: Permanently removes a category. The category cannot be deleted if products are still assigned to it (returns 400 Bad Request).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the category to delete

400.description: Invalid UUID or category still contains products

example.error: Cannot delete category because 2 products are still assigned to it. Please reassign or delete the products first.

get.description: Fetches all products joined with their category. Supports keyword search via `?search=<keyword>` (case-insensitive, partial match on product_name) and category filter by name via `?category=<name>` (case-insensitive, partial match). Both can be combined.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive keyword search on product name (partial match)

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Case-insensitive partial match on category name. Supports comma-separated values for multi-select (e.g. 'Rice,Addon' matches products in either category).

post.summary: Create a new product (with custom product_id)
post.description: Inserts a new product into the PostgreSQL database. Testers can add their own `product_id` (must be a valid UUID, e.g. `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001`). If the same `product_id` is used again, PostgreSQL unique constraint detects it and returns a 409 Conflict error.

example.product_details: House special with char siu, egg, and scallions

message.example: Product "Yang Special Fried Rice" created successfully

400.description: Validation error (invalid price, missing name, or non-existent category_id)

example.error: Category with ID "c0000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000302" does not exist.
Product ID "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" already exists. Duplicate IDs are not allowed.

get.description: Fetches a single product record by its UUID.

put.description: Updates fields on an existing product (partial update). Send only the properties you want to modify.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the product to update

example.product_details: Updated recipe with extra scrambled eggs and scallions

message.example: Product "Yang Special Fried Rice" updated successfully

delete.description: Permanently removes a product from the database.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: UUID of the product to delete

message.example: Product "Yang Special Fried Rice" deleted successfully

post.description: Validates an address using Nominatim (OpenStreetMap) geocoding. If Nominatim is unreachable, falls back to simple text-based validation (checks length and presence of a house number).

value.formatted_address: 123 Rizal Avenue, Quezon City, Metro Manila, Philippines

value.message: Address could not be found. Please check the address and try again.
Address accepted (external validation unavailable — verified by format only).
Address should include a house or building number.

400.description: Validation error (address too short, too long, or missing)

example.error: Address must be at least 5 characters

get.description: Lists all registered employee accounts. Requires manager role.

post.description: Creates a Supabase Auth user and corresponding employee record. Requires manager role.

delete.description: Deletes the employee record and Auth user. Prevents self-deletion. Requires manager role.

patch.description: Updates employee role with role hierarchy enforcement (manager > staff > rider). Requires manager.

get.description: Lists all registered customer accounts including active and disabled status. Requires manager.

patch.description: Updates customer details or enables/disables the account via is_account_disabled. Requires manager.

delete.description: Deletes customer record and associated Auth user. Requires manager role.

get.description: Lists orders with joined customer name, item details, delivery info, and transaction status. Filterable by status and date range. Requires admin, manager, or staff.

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Filter orders created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: Filter orders created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

get.description: Returns order counts grouped by status (received, preparing, out_for_delivery, completed, cancelled, total). Requires admin, manager, or staff.
Retrieves complete order detail including customer info, product line items, payment transaction, and delivery record. Requires admin, manager, or staff.

patch.description: Updates order status through stages: received -> preparing -> out_for_delivery -> completed (or cancelled from any non-completed stage). Requires admin, manager, or staff.

400.description: Invalid status transition or validation error

get.description: Returns sales revenue, order counts, period averages, and breakdown grouped by frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, yearly). Requires admin or manager.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Grouping frequency: daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly (default: daily)

get.description: Generates formatted PDF sales report grouped by frequency. Returns base64 data URI by default, or application/pdf binary file when ?format=raw. Requires admin or manager.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Grouping frequency: daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly (default: daily)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: 'json' (datauri base64) or 'raw' (binary PDF download)

get.description: Returns platform operational & growth metrics: registered customer growth, completion/cancellation rates, revenue trend vs previous period, and top selling products. Requires admin or manager.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to 30 days ago.

parameters.name: top_products
parameters.description: Number of top selling products to return (1-50, default 5)

get.description: Generates formatted PDF platform performance report including platform KPIs, revenue trend, and top selling products. Returns base64 data URI by default, or application/pdf binary file when ?format=raw. Requires admin or manager.

parameters.name: top_products
parameters.description: Number of top selling products to include (1-50, default 5)

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format: 'json' (datauri base64) or 'raw' (binary PDF download)

post.description: Persists a report record into the database reports table. Requires manager.
Authenticates an employee and sets session cookies in the browser. After executing this in Swagger, all protected endpoints will have your employee session automatically.

get.description: Returns the employee profile and role of the currently authenticated session.

post.description: Signs out the current session and clears the session cookies.

patch.description: Temporarily disables or re-enables an employee account. Enforces role hierarchy: Manager can disable Staff and Rider (except self); Staff/Rider cannot disable anyone.

post.description: Allows any authenticated employee (MANAGER, STAFF, RIDER) to update their own password.

patch.description: Allows higher-ups to reset another employee's password with role hierarchy enforcement: MANAGER can reset STAFF and RIDER; STAFF/RIDER cannot reset others.
